name: Boston Athenæum
note: These are the 593 paintings and sculptures the Athenæum publishes online: portraits of Bostonians, busts and casts bought for its first art gallery in the 1800s, Allan Rohan Crite’s Boston scenes and more. Many hang in the reading rooms on the upper floors, which only members and day members see. The Athenæum does not say online where each one is, so only the few it names are on the map.
